help_desc: Mutes, kennylizes or shadowmutes a user, ungags a restricted user, or lists the restricted users. The duration is optional.
msg_add_user: [ GAG ]--> User:  %s  was gagged with mode:  %s  |  by:  %s
msg_add_user_with_duration: [ GAG ]--> User:  %s  was gagged with mode:  %s  for  %s  |  by:  %s
msg_denied: You are not allowed to use this command.
msg_error_in: User is already gagged. Remove the current restriction before adding another.
msg_god: You are not allowed to gag this user.
msg_invalid_duration: Invalid duration. Use e.g. 30s / 10m / 2h / 1d / 1w (combinable: 1h30m). Empty = permanent.
msg_off: User not found or not registered.
